question: Found 2026-10-27 while building the pre-scored arming replay the owner asked for: the frozen entry score's vol_ratio, liquidity and toward24 are computed at the touch bar (ledger entry_i == touch_i_hint), not the bar before. How much does the score and the selection change when they use the bar before the touch?
single_variable: Bar of the three bar features: ledger entry_i (touch bar, stored) vs touch - 1 (causal); frozen model, events and outcomes unchanged.
null_control: Not a directional experiment. The control is reproduction: the touch-bar recomputation must equal the stored scores (max abs diff ~0), so any causal difference is the bar shift alone. Outcomes are compared on identical events (v2 near-edge net) and identical fills (v3_be0).
